proposal_title: Asset Versioning & Character/Style Continuity Scoring Invariants
domain_specific_rationale: From a Contracts and Data Integrity perspective, CP-012 standardizes the AssetVersion, CharacterVersion, and StyleVersion schema contracts in domain-entities.schema.json. It mandates critical integrity fields: checksum_sha256 (validated via pattern ^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$), byte_size (minimum 1), mime_type, origin_uri, source_type, and license_type. By decoupling vendor-specific embeddings and LoRA weights into optional custom_attributes, the contract accommodates multimodal providers while enforcing immutable asset provenance and cryptographic verification at contract boundaries.
evidence_citations: review-session/FREEZE_REMEDIATION_V1/REVISED_SPEC_CANDIDATE/02_contracts/domain-entities.schema.json:lines 470-610 (AssetVersion, CharacterVersion, StyleVersion schema definitions and checksum regex)
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-06 (Assets & Continuity Invariants) and CAP-01 (Canonical Core State).
residual_risk: Invalid URI protocols in storage_uri or origin_uri could lead to retrieval errors. Mitigated by URI format validation and storage adapter conformance test suites.
